digest.component_or_area: route reconciler differ/apply core-importer sites off vendor mappers
propositions: Core reconciler differ and apply phases directly imported vendor-specific mapper entrypoints (_map_local_to_jira_fields, _map_jira_to_local_fields), violating backend neutrality; they must instead receive mappers via Backend-port dependency injection.
outbound_differ, inbound_differ, and apply_inbound module-level imports of Jira vendor mappers must be removed and replaced with injected Backend-port mapper parameters.
outbound_links._RELATION_TO_JIRA_LINK constant must be relocated from differ core to adapters/jira/jira_fields.py and imported from the canonical location.
Injected mappers must be actually invoked by differ phases (not bypassed), verified by positive injection tests with fake mappers.
Full reconcile unit and integration test suite must remain green after injection wiring and all linting/typecheck gates must pass.
